run_vision_classification_cli: run the vision classification CLI client to classify text, image, and video via a vLLM API server
test_parse_args: test the parse_args function to build an argparse parser with host and port arguments
test_main: test the main function to send multimodal classification requests to a vLLM server
run_text_classification: run text classification by sending a messages payload with assistant and user roles to the classify endpoint
run_image_classification: run image classification by sending a messages payload with image_url content to the classify endpoint
